findings.claim: `self.downsize` is defined twice in OptimizedImage. Ruby has no overloading, so the later (from, to, dimensions, opts) definition replaces the (from, to, max_width, max_height, opts) one, and existing 5-argument callers such as ResizeEmoji (app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14) raise ArgumentError.

verifier.reason: The patch defines `self.downsize` twice in `OptimizedImage` (app/models/optimized_image.rb:145 and app/models/optimized_image.rb:149), so the second 3..4-argument definition overwrites the first in Ruby. As a result, existing 5-argument callers like `Jobs::ResizeEmoji#execute` (app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14) will raise `ArgumentError`.

findings.claim: The same 10 MB constant is duplicated in several places, so the client and server limits can drift apart.

verifier.reason: The patch replaces shared site-setting lookups with hardcoded 10 MB literals in three separate places: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js:182, app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js:246, and app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb:55. Because these client and server values are unshared literals, they can drift apart if updated in only one place.
